clause_ref: FHFA news release, Conforming Loan Limit for 2027 (2026-11-24)
clause_path: 2027 CLL values: baseline one-unit $855,400; high-cost ceiling 150 percent of baseline (one-unit $1,283,100); AK/HI/GU/VI baseline and ceiling one-unit $1,283,100 and $1,924,650

obligations.label: 2027 baseline conforming loan limit for one-unit properties in most of the United States is $855,400
where 115 percent of the local median home value exceeds the baseline, the applicable limit is above the baseline
the high-cost area limit is set as a multiple of the area median home value
the high-cost ceiling is 150 percent of the baseline limit
Alaska, Hawaii, Guam and the U.S. Virgin Islands have different limits set by statute
in those four jurisdictions the 2027 one-unit baseline is $1,283,100 and the one-unit ceiling is $1,924,650
